dataset.name: Beaujon intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma cohort (GSE244807)
dataset.description: Independent intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma cohort with bulk total-RNA sequencing of FFPE biopsies or surgical specimens and individual overall-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: The source discovery cohort contains one RNA profile for each of 246 patients treated at Beaujon Hospital between 2000 and 2021. TRACE Explorer retains the 230 patients with positive overall-survival time and explicit vital status; the separate TCGA-CHOL and 32-case external validation sets described by the publication are not part of GSE244807.
dataset.publication_citation: Beaufrere et al. JHEP Reports 2026; Lubuela et al. Virchows Archiv 2024

metadata.source_program: Beaujon Hospital intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma discovery cohort
metadata.library_method: SMARTer Stranded Total RNA-seq from FFPE biopsy or surgical tumor tissue
metadata.redistribution_note: The GEO count matrix is analyzable in TRACE Explorer, but direct matrix redistribution remains disabled because GEO access alone does not resolve all submitter intellectual-property claims.
metadata.curation_note: GEO provides one expression identifier, age, sex, death status and overall-survival time for each source sample. Sixteen records report OS=0 and are excluded under the positive-time rule, leaving 230 endpoint-complete patients with 169 deaths and 61 censored observations. Library sizes are calculated over all 61,806 pinned featureCounts rows before log2(CPM + 1). Ensembl release 107 maps 41,389 rows to 40,189 symbols; 77 symbols represented by multiple Ensembl rows are excluded rather than combined, leaving 40,112 unambiguous genes.

samples.sample_role: Primary iCCA FFPE biopsy or surgical tumor specimen

expression.label: GEO counts normalized to log2(CPM + 1)
expression.mapping_source: Pinned Ensembl release 107 GRCh38 annotation declared by the source study
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Symbols mapped from more than one source Ensembl row are excluded rather than combined without an unambiguous gene-level rule.
expression.scale_note: TRACE Explorer computes each retained sample library size across all 61,806 pinned source rows, converts counts to CPM and applies log2(CPM + 1). Values are cohort-normalized and should not be compared directly with expression units from other releases.
